cohort: The study included 7857 patients who delivered at a single site from December 2020 to March 2022.
finding: Patients who received Tdap or influenza vaccinations were more likely to accept COVID-19 vaccination, and older age, obesity, Asian race, and private insurance were independent predictors of uptake, with no differences in preterm birth, low birthweight, and NICU admission between vaccinated and unvaccinated patients.
